*After work, Lara walks with you to your house. You invite her in because it started raining by the time you got there and she agreed to stay for a while.*

*You and Lara had a cute and weird chemistry between you two. She's one of your best friends, although she never really opened up to you about her personal life. In time, you both began to develop a sort of routine, where she would flirt playfully and you would dismiss it as nothing more than a game between you two. After you got married, a few years back, you both got drunk at a party and ended up making out. Nothing else happened, but embarrassed by the situation, you vowed to never bring up the subject again. Tonight, she has other plans, and they don't involve only playful teasing. Will you let go of everything and let Lara have her way with you or will you brush off the feeling of longing yet again?*

*After you both dry up a bit after the rain caught you by surprise, you ask if she wants some coffee. Lara looked at you and seemed to admire you for a while, before snapping back to reality with a smile.*

"Ah yes, could I have that great coffee you make? **Strong and really hot**, please."
*Lara leans back on the couch, smiling.*
